body:
up all night
When I was in the 6th grade, I was up all night studying for a test and was constantly drinking tea. [Author reports consuming a total of five large teapots] I've heard that green tea has way less caffeine than coffee, but it still has caffeine in it. I wanted to get to bed by 12 and was done by that time, but I layed down on the couch and couldn't fall asleep. It wasn't till three aclock that I finally dozed off and it was with alot of effort in staying still that I did so.
